Getting a single page of a multi page acoustic detections query

Source: R/get_acoustic_detections_page.R
get_acoustic_detections_page.Rd

A view was implemented that returns the next primary key id, this allows for optimized page wise detections querying to the database as no offset needs to be included.

Usage

get_acoustic_detections_page(
  credentials = list(username = Sys.getenv("ETN_USER"), password = Sys.getenv("ETN_PWD")),
  next_id_pk = 0,
  page_size = 1e+05,
  start_date = NULL,
  end_date = NULL,
  tag_serial_number = NULL,
  acoustic_tag_id = NULL,
  animal_project_code = NULL,
  scientific_name = NULL,
  acoustic_project_code = NULL,
  deployment_id = NULL,
  receiver_id = NULL,
  station_name = NULL,
  count = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

credentials

A list with the username and password to connect to the ETN database.

next_id_pk

The next primary key to fetch. All detections have a sequential id, this key allows us to read the view top to bottom, but filter out any records with lower detection_ids the one we've already fetched. By default, start reading at the first detection. Returned records have a detection_id higher than next_id_pk.

page_size

The number of records to retrieve.

start_date

Character. Start date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format ( yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm or yyyy).

end_date

Character. End date (exclusive) in ISO 8601 format ( yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm or yyyy).

tag_serial_number

Character (vector). One or more tag serial numbers.

acoustic_tag_id

Character (vector). One or more acoustic tag ids.

animal_project_code

Character (vector). One or more animal project codes. Case-insensitive.

scientific_name

Character (vector). One or more scientific names.

acoustic_project_code

Character (vector). One or more acoustic project codes. Case-insensitive.

deployment_id

Character (vector). One or more deployment ids.

receiver_id

Character (vector). One or more receiver identifiers.

station_name

Character (vector). One or more deployment station names.

count

Logical. If set to TRUE a data.frame is returned with a single column: the count of the number of records returned by the query. page_size is ignored.

...

Additional arguments passed to the function. Not used. Handy if extra arguments are passed as a side effect of do.call()

Value

A tibble with acoustic detections data, with length page_size or smaller. Including a column with the primary key of the next detection.
